## Project Analysis Report

### 1. Project Type

This is **Tocly - Admin & Dashboard Template** from [themesdesign.in](https://themesdesign.in) — a **static HTML/CSS/JS admin dashboard theme**. It is **not** an ASP.NET / C# project — there are no `.sln`, `.csproj`, `web.config`, or `package.json` files. This is a pure frontend Bootstrap 5 template with:

- **90+ HTML pages** (dashboards, charts, forms, tables, UI components, auth, layouts, etc.)
- **Minified CSS** (Bootstrap 5 + custom app theme)
- **jQuery/ApexCharts/Chart.js** for data visualization
- **Material Design Icons + Font Awesome** for icons
- **HTTrack-copied** static snapshot of the live theme (evidenced by the "Mirrored from" comment in `index.html`)

**Root folder:** `assets/` with subfolders: `css/`, `js/`, `fonts/`, `images/`, `libs/`

### 2. Current Primary/Theme Color

**The primary theme color is `#0c768a`** (a teal/cyan). A secondary dark-teal `#086070` is used for sidebar hover/active states.

The color `#00519b` you mentioned does **not exist** anywhere in this project.

### 3. Color Definitions Summary

#### Bootstrap Theme Colors (`bootstrap.min.css` line 5)

```css
--bs-primary: #0c768a              /* PRIMARY THEME COLOR */
--bs-primary-rgb: 12, 118, 138
--bs-secondary: #8590a5
--bs-success: #38c786
--bs-info: #4e9def
--bs-warning: #f4ba40
--bs-danger: #ed5e49
--bs-blue: #2651e9
--bs-indigo: #564ab1
--bs-purple: #986de5
--bs-pink: #e83e8c
```

#### Custom Theme CSS Variables (`app.min.css` line 1, near end)

```css
--bs-sidebar-menu-item-hover-color: #086070     /* Sidebar hover */
--bs-sidebar-menu-item-active-color: #086070    /* Sidebar active */
--bs-menu-item-active-color: #086070            /* Topnav active */
--bs-sidebar-bg: #ffffff
--bs-header-bg: #f5f8f9
```

#### Dark Mode Overrides (in `app.min.css`, `[data-bs-theme=dark]`)

```css
--bs-sidebar-bg: #182028
--bs-sidebar-menu-item-color: #7d848f
--bs-header-bg: #0e1217
```

#### Topbar "Brand" Theme Override

```css
--bs-header-bg: #17318c   /* A blue brand variant */
```

### 4. All Files Containing Color Definitions

| # | File Path | What It Defines |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `assets\css\bootstrap.min.css` | **Primary source** — `--bs-primary: #0c768a` + all Bootstrap theme colors |
| 2 | `assets\css\app.min.css` | **Secondary source** — Custom CSS variables, sidebar/hover/active colors + dark mode |
| 3 | `assets\css\app-rtl.min.css` | RTL version — same variable structure as `app.min.css` |
| 4 | `assets\js\layout.js` | Dark/light mode toggle (via `data-bs-theme` attribute on `<html>`) |
| 5 | `assets\js\pages\dashboard.init.js` | Dashboard chart colors: `#0c768a` used in ApexCharts configs |
| 6 | `assets\js\pages\apexcharts-*.init.js` (18 files) | ApexCharts chart configs using `#0c768a` and `#2651e9` |
| 7 | `index.html` | Sets `data-sidebar="colored"` which triggers the `body[data-sidebar=colored]` CSS rules in `app.min.css` (sidebar background = `#0c768a`) |
| 8 | `form-elements.html` | Color picker demo input has `value="#086070"` |

### 5. Key Findings

- **No SCSS/LESS source files exist** — all CSS is minified. The original source (likely SCSS) was not included in the download.
- **No `.skin` files** — this is not an ASP.NET-themed project.
- **Central place to change primary color**: You'd need to replace `#0c768a` across all files listed above, particularly `bootstrap.min.css` (the `--bs-primary` variable and all hardcoded usages) and `app.min.css` (hardcoded usages of both `#0c768a` and `#086070`). The theme switching is handled via CSS custom properties and the `data-bs-theme` / `data-sidebar` / `data-topbar` HTML attributes.
